import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

MAX_DRIVERS = 4

def design(feats):
    # Calculate t-statistics for all features
    t_stats = []
    for fid in feats.ids:
        idx = feats.column(fid)
        t_stat = abs(stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[feats.y==1, idx], feats.x[feats.y==0, idx]).statistic)
        t_stats.append(t_stat)
    
    # Get top features by t-statistic
    top_indices = np.argsort(t_stats)[::-1][:MAX_DRIVERS]
    drivers = tuple(feats.ids[i] for i in top_indices)
    
    # Simple approach: use top features as both drivers and columns
    # No products, simple weighted sum with t-statistics as weights
    loadings = {}
    for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids):
        if i in top_indices:
            idx = feats.column(fid)
            t_stat = abs(stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[feats.y==1, idx], feats.x[feats.y==0, idx]).statistic)
            loadings[fid] = t_stat
    
    # Normalize loadings
    total_weight = sum(loadings.values()) if loadings else 1
    if total_weight > 0:
        for fid in loadings:
            loadings[fid] /= total_weight
    
    return Design(
        drivers=drivers,
        columns=drivers,
        products=(),
        loadings=loadings
    )
